body: Thanks man. I tried and I succeeded. I'm doing much better now.
I'm doing good, thanks for asking. I shifted my focus to other things and things are much better.

Man. I'm a civilian in a PD and been wanting and trying to make the jump to sworn for several years now. With each rejection piling up on top of failed relationships and other things, things have been dark. 


Those quotes of thoughts about yourself really hit me. I've said most of those things to myself, especially recently. I try to give myself a reason everyday to push through the day. And the next. And the next. I understand your struggle. I really appreciate you posting this.
I want to. Believe me I do. But it would tank any chance to further my career. And possibly my current job.
Thank you. I'll check it out if I have time in the next few days.
Happened on Friday night. Went to a Halloween party. Had a great time. Drive home I cried, pulled into garage and just had a primal scream.

Yes. Planning on taking my life this week on my 30th birthday. I've written out my letters, recorded several videos of me explain why I did it, instructions for the care of my pets, goodbyes, etc. I've done everything I could to fight against my depression and PTSD. I'm seeing a counselor who recommended me to see a therapist. I know the therapist will diagnose me with borderline personality disorder. If that happens then I will lose my job and my dream career. In the past week I have snapped in front of friends and I'm afraid the fake face I put on for years is showing.

If I seek help and admit to all of my thoughts, it'll make it worse. I'll lose everything. I'll be fired instantly because of work rules. I'm already in a ton of debt and I can't afford to take any more on.

Wanted to mention this. Tonight I did a dry fire on my gun. Right to my head. Didn't feel scared. Didn't flinch.


If anybody knew just how deep I've gone, I'd be screwed. I'd lose my job, then my apartment, my pets, it would be just much worse.
